title: Tune the curation gates without erasing the long tail
description: Select a corpus slice, change the quality and near-duplicate thresholds, and choose an evaluation decontamination policy. The funnel shows what survives and what risk remains.
note: The cohort shares and response curves are illustrative. Calibrate them with labeled accept/reject samples, duplicate clusters, and a private evaluation inventory.

scenarios.label: English-heavy web
scenarios.detail: A broad crawl where the quality model has strong in-language calibration.

scenarios.label: Multilingual web
scenarios.detail: A mixed-language crawl where one global quality threshold can over-reject smaller language communities.

scenarios.label: Technical and code
scenarios.detail: Documentation and repositories with repeated templates, mirrors, and benchmark-like examples.

decontaminationPolicies.label: No evaluation inventory
decontaminationPolicies.detail: Keep every surviving document. Fast, but benchmark overlap remains invisible.

decontaminationPolicies.label: Exact fingerprint
decontaminationPolicies.detail: Remove exact evaluation matches while retaining paraphrases and transformed copies.

decontaminationPolicies.label: Exact and near-match
decontaminationPolicies.detail: Use normalized text, n-gram similarity, and review for high-impact benchmark families.
